evidence_scope: A-side no-BLIND scheduler-control fixture only; raw captures remain A-only
observed_lifecycle: held then exactly one bresume then DONE
hash_representation: Complete SHA-256 digests are recorded here; raw bytes remain A-side only.
semantic_observations: custom bjobs delimiter rows have exactly 11 fields and no trailing delimiter field
bhist resume evidence is Signal <CONT> requested plus Waiting for scheduling after resumed
bhist start is Starting (Pid) and successful terminal is Done successfully
bacct successful terminal is Status <DONE> plus Completed <done>
wrapper UTC metadata establishes control-operation order and the five-hour capture window only; it is not numerically compared with LSF event-text timestamps
raw_storage_rule: No raw scheduler, stdout, stderr, candidate, result-path, run-id, or runtime rows are mirrored into Git.
